book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Taim po go insaid da bot ane stat blo big pladwata
Den da AntapGod i bin spik po Noa, ‘Diskaintaim go insaid da bigbot, yu ane ol pamle blo yu. Wa! Ai bin luk prom ebridem pipol dat mata yu i meke ebriting wea i prapa rait ane stret prant lo mi.
Tekem wea yu seben man animal ane seben oman animal wea i bin spik i gud po kaikai. Dem seimwan i rait po banem antap lo olta po wosip God. Teke tutu prom ol dem nada animal.
Ane teke seben blo ebri man ane oman pizin, solong dem pizin i go mata stap laip prom da pladwata ane ol i go gad pikinini gen ya lo ert.
Prom tidei, wen i go kese namba seben dei, ai go sane rein po poldaun ya lo ert po poti dei ane poti nait, ane ebri laipsamting wea ai bin mekem, ai go tekemaute laip prom ebriwan dempla.’
Noa i bin meke ebriting prapa stret wea da AntapGod i bin odarem po mekem.
Wen Noa i bin kese 600 iya oul, prapa big pladwata wea i bin kam, i bin mata ran kabare da ert.
Noa ane oman blo em, ol boi blo em ane ol oman blo demtri boi, ol i bin go insaid lo da bigbot po aid prom da prapa big pladwata.
Melen wea Noa ane pamle blo em, i bin gad ol dem animal i gud po kaikai ane po banem antap lo olta po wosip God, ane ol dem nadalot animal, ane ol dem pizin ane ol dem smolanimal.
Dempla ol i bin go tutu go insaid po da bot wea Noa, wiskain God i bin oda Noa po mekem.
Apta dem seben dei i bin pinis, da big pladwata i bin stat po mata ran kam antap ane kabare da ert.
Wen Noa i bin kese 600 iya oul ane lo da sebentin dei blo namba tu mant, ebridem spring blo prapa bigwata andanit wea da graun i bin bas kam antap go ausaid, ane da skai bin open wase winda.
Rein bin poldaun antap wea da lan po poti dei ane poti nait.
Lo dat seimdei Noa ane oman blo Noa, ane ol boi blo em, Sem, Am, ane Zapet, ane oman blo demtri boi blo Noa, bin go insaid da bigbot.

Ebri olkain animal ol i bin go wea dempla, ebri olkain teimanimal wea i gud po kaikai ane ebri olkain wailanimal, ane ebri olkain smolanimal ane ebri olkain pizin, ebri olkain laipsamting wea i gad ol wing.
Tutu ol bin lego kam insaid wea da bot,
manwan ane omanwan, seimkain wanem God i bin oda. Den da AntapGod i bin sate doa blo da bot.
God tekemaut laip blo ebri nada pipol prom da big pladwata
Da prapa big pladwata i bin mata go, ran kam antap kabare ert po poti dei ane poti nait, ane da wata i bin kip kam plenti ane plenti, ane da bigbot bin plot go rait antap prom da lan.
Da wata i bin kip kam mobig, ane i bin kam prapa nadakain plenti lo da lan, ane da bigbot bin plot, seipwan antap lo wata.
Da wata i bin kip kam prapa nadakain big, i bin kabare ebridem prapa big ai maunten.
Da wata bin kip kam kese seben mita antap lo dem big ai maunten.
Ane mina olkain laipsamting ya lo ert i bin ded: ol dem dipren pizin, ol dem dipren teimanimal, ol dem dipren wailanimal, ol dem dipren laipsamting wea i wagbaut antap lo da graun ane ebridem pipol.
Ebrisamting lo da drai graun wea i ole win i bin ded.

Ebri laipsamting wea i bin stap wea ert i bin distroi: ebridem pipol, ebridem smolanimal ane ebridem biganimal ane ebridem pizin. Ebri demting i bin distroi. Mata Noa ane pamle blo em ane dem animal wea i bin insaid wea da bot i bin laip.
Ane da wata bin kabare ert po 150 dei.
